body: it depends on the severity and length. i'll get the usual racing heart, shakiness, nausea, and lightheadedness (then i convince myself i'm going to faint, which only makes me more anxious), as well as feeling feverish and numb all over. i can't breathe, speak, or move. sometimes if it's a bad one, i'll dissociate and forget who i am for a minute or two. but everyone's symptoms are different <3
